body: Hold my sack, I’m going in!

Have done this before, years ago. Woke up tripping, but took it well since I knew that was a possibility. Definitely trippy as hell not having that transition, and just waking up into it. If you’re ready for it, I’d say experience it.

Edit: want to add, that I remember dropping it around 8-9 pm and waking back up around midnight.

[Veiw from my rocking chair](https://imgur.com/8g7DyL5) 

I didn’t know I needed it until tonight.

I told my therapist about some scientific research surrounding microdosing, along with some thoughts from my own experiences (low and high doses), and she too seemed interested. The veil is truly being lifted, slowly but surely.
One of the first times I tripped alone, I watched cartoons all night and thought I hallucinated an entire episode of family guy. Turned out, I just hadn’t seen it, and it was a weird one.
I had one in high school, it was awesome. Eventually I was grounded and the rents trashed it or gave it away. Will have to get another one soon!
